name: Media
description: Video, audio and galleries. Crystal named none of these before. The parity requirement here is about capability: a design system without a transport control leaves every product to invent one, and each invention re-solves captions, scrubbing and keyboard transport differently.

components.name: Video player
components.anatomy: A media stage at a set aspect ratio holding the video, a caption cue above the transport, and the transport inset from the stage: play, skip, the scrubber with its two time readouts, mute and volume, then a settings menu (playback speed, subtitles and captions, audio track, quality), picture in picture and full screen.
components.material: Resin transport over the video with Haze fills behind its time readouts; Stone behind caption cues; Frost settings menu
components.geometry: The stage keeps the content radius and the aspect ratio the product sets (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 9:16 or the media's own). The transport is a pill inset 12px from the stage, or the safe area in full screen, with 4px block padding around its controls (58px with its rim); every control reaches the 48px action target. Caption cues sit above the transport, never under it. Below 420px the transport wraps its trailing controls onto a second row.
components.semantics: Native video element underneath. Controls are real buttons, captions are supported and their state is announced, and keyboard shortcuts do not trap focus. Speed, subtitle, audio-track and quality choices are menus of radio items (menuitemradio with aria-checked); the selected item is shown by label weight, never a check mark, and each change is announced in words. A choice the engine cannot make (an audio track list where the browser exposes none, picture in picture where it is unsupported) is not offered.
components.crystal: Stage, transport and caption materials, transport geometry and insets, the settings menu, the motion of showing and hiding controls
components.product: Sources, caption and audio tracks, quality renditions and their switching (adaptive streaming), DRM, analytics

components.name: Audio player
components.anatomy: A Haze card holding the title and any secondary line (artist, episode, chapter), with the transport inset from its edge: play, skip, the scrubber with its two time readouts, mute and volume, and a settings menu for playback speed.
components.material: Haze card holding a Resin transport; Frost settings menu
components.geometry: The card keeps the content radius and the card padding (20px); the transport is a pill with 4px block padding around its controls; the scrubber is a slider with a 44px thumb.
components.semantics: A real audio element. The scrubber is a slider announcing time, not a progress bar.

components.name: Media controls
components.anatomy: The shared transport used by both players: play, skip, the scrubber between two time readouts, mute and volume, then the controls a player adds (settings, picture in picture, full screen).
components.material: Resin plane; Haze behind the time readouts
components.geometry: Pill with 4px block and 12px inline padding around its 48px controls (58px tall with its rim), 4px between them. Time readouts are tabular and sit on Haze pills.
components.semantics: Each control is a button with a name; play and pause are one toggle with a pressed state.
components.crystal: Materials, the press recipe on every control

components.name: Gallery
components.anatomy: A set of media with a full-screen viewer.
components.material: Thumbnails are Haze; the viewer sits on a Mirage scrim
components.geometry: Thumbnails keep the content radius; the viewer is full-bleed within the scrim.
components.semantics: The viewer is a dialog: focus is contained, Escape closes, and arrows move between items with position announced.
components.crystal: Scrim material, thumbnail material, the transition between thumbnail and viewer
components.product: The media set and its captions

components.name: Lightbox
components.anatomy: A single media item enlarged over a scrim.
components.material: Mirage scrim; the item sits above it
components.geometry: The item keeps its own aspect; the scrim is full-bleed.
components.semantics: A dialog. Zoom and pan are keyboard reachable, and closing returns focus to the thumbnail.
components.crystal: Scrim material, the open and close motion
